from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, os, re, hashlib, datetime
import yaml
r=Path.home()/"CheshireAraPULP"

env=dict(os.environ,GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0",PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1",PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK="1")
def cmd(args,cwd=r):
 p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=str(cwd),env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=45)
 return {"rc":p.returncode,"output":p.stdout.strip()}
def stat(p):
 return {"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"mtime_utc":datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(p.stat().st_mtime,datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
out={"root":str(r)}
lock=yaml.safe_load((r/"Bender.lock").read_text())["packages"]
out["root_head"]=cmd(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"])
out["lock_unchanged"]=cmd(["git","diff","--exit-code","HEAD","--","Bender.lock","Bender.yml"])
deps=[]
for d in sorted((r/".bender/git/checkouts").iterdir()):
 if not d.is_dir():continue
 name=d.name.rsplit("-",1)[0]
 if name not in lock:continue
 h=cmd(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],d)
 deps.append({"name":name,"head":h["output"],"locked":lock[name]["revision"],"matches":h["output"]==lock[name]["revision"],"diff":cmd(["git","diff","--stat","HEAD"],d)["output"]})
out["deps"]=deps
out["printf"]=cmd(["git","submodule","status","sw/deps/printf"])
out["pip_check"]=cmd([str(r/".venv/bin/python"),"-m","pip","check"])
out["python_versions"]=cmd([str(r/".venv/bin/python"),"-c","import sys, importlib.metadata as m; print(sys.version); print({n:m.version(n) for n in ['pip','tclint','importlib-metadata','pathspec','tomli']})"])
p=r/"target/sim/vcs/compile.cheshire_soc.sh"
s=p.read_text()
active="\n".join(x for x in s.splitlines() if not x.lstrip().startswith("#"))
out["filelist"]={"stat":stat(p),"profile_lines":[l.strip() for l in active.splitlines() if "_config_pkg.sv" in l],"decoder_lines":[l.strip() for l in active.splitlines() if "cva6_accel_first_pass_decoder.sv" in l],"defines":sorted(set(re.findall(r'\+define\+[^\s"]+',active))),"vlogan_lines":[l for l in active.splitlines() if "vlogan" in l][:6],"root_line":[l for l in s.splitlines() if l.startswith("ROOT")]}
out["tb_config"]="\n".join(l for l in (r/"target/sim/src/tb_cheshire_pkg.sv").read_text().splitlines() if any(x in l for x in ["Ara","2048","// 3:"]))
out["logs"]={}
for name in ["elaborate.log","simulate.log"]:
 p=r/"target/sim/vcs"/name
 if p.exists():
  lines=p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
